description: Create a folder, at the top level or inside a parent folder (folders nest without a depth limit). Folders are public unless public is false; a password protects one. The API offers no way to rename a folder or change its public setting or password afterwards. Returns the new identifier, name, parent and hasPassword.

parent.description: Parent folder identifier for a subfolder; leave out (or "root") for the top level

parent_id.description: The same as parent (the API accepts either name)

password.description: A password that protects the folder

public.description: true for public (the default), false for private; sent as 1 or 0

name: create_folder
title: Create a folder
